name: Kruševo (North Macedonia)
description: A vertical red banner bearing the flag of the Kruševo detachment of 1903 — a golden torch within a wreath with the motto СМРТ ИЛИ СЛОБОДА (Death or Freedom).
history: Reproduces the banner of the Kruševo insurgent detachment of the 1903 Ilinden Uprising.

features.role: torch within a wreath, with the motto Death or Freedom
